build_ast_node_encoder: build an ASTNodeEncoder Haiku module to encode graph nodes with type, attribute, and depth embeddings
create_vocab_mapping: create a vocabulary mapping from a list of token sequences with UNK and EOS special tokens
augment_graph_edges: augment graph edges with AST edges, inverse edges, and next-token edges for code graphs
encode_sequence_to_array: encode a list of words into a padded JAX array using a vocabulary index mapping
decode_array_to_sequence: decode a JAX array of token indices back into a list of words filtering UNK tokens
